summary: Once a day it casts Charm Monster (DC 15; non-Humanoids save with Disadvantage); attuned, you're proficient in Arcana, History, Nature or Religion.
text: While holding this book you can cast Charm Monster (save DC 15) from it once per dawn; a creature that isn't a Humanoid makes the save with Disadvantage. While attuned to it you have proficiency in one skill you choose from Arcana, History, Nature and Religion, and you can change the choice when you finish a Long Rest. (The game's Study action already reveals a creature's damage defenses on a success.)

powers.name: Choose a Subject
powers.text: After a Long Rest: pick the skill the bestiary teaches you.
